items.title: C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW) Extends Credit For RXO Deal, Is The Valuation Still Compelling?
items.summary: C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW) has just reworked its core financing, extending its revolving credit facility to 2031 and expanding total commitments to US$1.25b. This move is closely tied to its pending RXO acquisition. Recent moves have landed C.H. Robinson Worldwide squarely back on investor radar.
